# AMIS browser SDK

Version 6.13.0, https://github.com/baidu/amis/tree/6.13.0. Apache-2.0. LICENSE is copied verbatim from that tag (Git blob f2c52afa1fa6a8555d7fd85afb7b26c0765a9a9b). The npm distribution omits the root LICENSE, so the build script includes this copy. The published unmodified SDK is fetched at build time. Upstream bundled third-party notices are retained when supplied. Full bundled dependency and license audit remains a production release gate.
